title: Триггер: BY THE TIME (К тому времени как)
description: Раскрой скобки, используя Future Perfect или Future Simple (в главном предложении).

items.sentence: By the time you (come) ___, I (finish) ___ my homework.
By the time she (arrive) ___, the train (leave) ___.
By the time we (finish) ___ the work, it (get) ___ dark.
By the time he (wake up) ___, his parents (go) ___ to work.
By the time they (call) ___, I (fall) ___ asleep.
